title: Four Integers, One Turn
summary: Lie brackets with an invariant form, and rational rotations written with four integers. In a plane, a bracket that keeps a nondegenerate invariant form is orthogonal to both inputs and shrinks to zero (the chapter's written argument); in the non-Abelian three-dimensional case Lean checks, on the classical Mathlib side, that a positive invariant form makes the bracket a positive multiple of the cross product in a suitable basis. The quarter turn p_Half = (1, 1, 0, 0) has squared norm 2, yet conjugating by it and dividing by 2 gives the exact rotation (x, y, z) → (x, −z, y); (−2, 2, 2, 2) is reduced by its gcd 2 and a sign flip to the canonical name (1, −1, −1, −1) (computed on screen). Lean checks, in the Omega library, four-square multiplicativity, left ray absorption, the four-dimensional Lagrange identity and κ ≤ 1; the worked values |(1 + i)(1 + j)|² = 4, triad(1 + i, 1 + i, g120) = (2, 2, 2, 2), κ(p0, p_Half) = 1/2 and the six squared minors 1 + 1 + 0 + 1 + 0 + 0 = 3 are computed. g120 = (1, 1, 1, 1) returns to p0 in three canonical beats and in six with signs kept (computed). The two orders (1 + i)(1 + j) = (1, 1, 1, 1) and (1 + j)(1 + i) = (1, 1, 1, −1) are shown with their exact integer rotation matrices, and Lean checks they never share a ray. Finally, rational points of a circle stand in schematically for the rational unit quaternions, which leave gaps (hand derivation); for a noncommutative, chain-connected, zero-reaching real comparison model with a five-dimensional Euclidean feature map, Lean checks a bijection onto the unit quaternions once reading completeness is added; the rank-10 squared reading and antipodal gluing of canonical ternions are the chapter's reading.
summary_zh: 从带不变型的李括号讲到用四个整数表示有理旋转。在平面里，保持非退化不变型的括号同时与两个输入正交，只能缩为零（本章书面论证）；在三维非交换情形，Lean 在经典 Mathlib 侧检验：正定不变型使括号在适当基底下成为叉积的正倍数。四分之一圈 p_Half = (1, 1, 0, 0) 的模方为 2，但用它共轭再除以 2 就得到精确旋转 (x, y, z) → (x, −z, y)；(−2, 2, 2, 2) 经最大公约数 2 约分并翻号，得到规范名 (1, −1, −1, −1)（屏幕计算）。Lean 在 Omega 库中检验四平方乘性、射线左消去、四维拉格朗日恒等式与 κ ≤ 1；算例 |(1 + i)(1 + j)|² = 4、triad(1 + i, 1 + i, g120) = (2, 2, 2, 2)、κ(p0, p_Half) = 1/2 与六个子式平方 1 + 1 + 0 + 1 + 0 + 0 = 3 为屏幕计算。g120 = (1, 1, 1, 1) 按规范名三拍回到 p0，保留符号则需六拍（屏幕计算）。两种次序 (1 + i)(1 + j) = (1, 1, 1, 1) 与 (1 + j)(1 + i) = (1, 1, 1, −1) 连同各自的精确整数旋转矩阵并排对照，Lean 检验二者永不共射线。最后，圆上的有理点示意有理单位四元数留下的缝隙（手工推导）；对非交换、链连通、触零且有五维欧氏特征实现的实值比较模型，再加读数完备性，Lean 检验模型双射到全体单位四元数；规范整三元数秩 10 的平方读数与对径点粘合是本章的诠释。
